استهدين (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَيْنَ (istahdayna) /is.tah.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اُسْتُهْدِينَ (ustuhdīna) /us.tuh.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اِسْتَهْدِينَ (istahdīna) /is.tah.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
